SelectorQueryNodesRef.fields(Object fields, function callback)

Obtain node information. The fields to be obtained are specified in fields. The return value is SelectorQuery corresponding to NodesRef.

Parameter

Object fields

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
id Boolean false No Whether to return the node ID.
dataset Boolean false No Whether to return the node dataset.
rect Boolean false No Whether to return the node layout position (left, right, top, or bottom).
size Boolean false No Whether to return the node size (width or height).
scrollOffset Boolean false No Whether to return scrollLeft or scrollTop of the node. The node must be scroll-view or viewport.
properties Array [] No Attribute name list. The return value is the attribute values of the node. (Only the common attribute values marked in the component document can be obtained. id, class, style and attribute values bound to events cannot be obtained.)

function callback

Callback function.

Parameter

Object res

Node information.

Return Value

SelectorQuery

Sample Code

Page({
  getFields () {
    ma.createSelectorQuery().select('#the-id').fields({
      dataset: true,
      size: true,
      scrollOffset: true,
      properties: ['scrollX', 'scrollY']
    }, function (res) {
      res.dataset    // Node dataset.
      res.dataset    //Width of the node.
      res.height     //Height of the node.
      res.scrollLeft // Horizontal scrolling position of the node.
      res.scrollTop  // Vertical scrolling position of the node.
      res.scrollX    // Value of the scroll-x attribute of the node.
      res.scrollY    // Value of the scroll-y attribute of the node.
    }).exec()
  }
})
